text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Observed p99 spike on streaming API /v1/stream -> SLO at risk. Auto-paging engaged. Notifying on-call @sam.

sam: saw the page. Looking now. p95 up ~300ms, p99 up to 4.2s for streaming responses. Any alerts for cache hitrate?

priya: cache hit-rate for prefix cache dropped drastically ~ 92% -> 14% at 03:12 UTC. Correlates with a prefix-hash rollout we did last night (prefix-hash v4).

maria: confirmed. Metrics: requests/sec steady, but streaming tail latency and stalled chunks increasing. Some clients report stalled streams where tokens stop for 2-6s then resume.

alex: adding logs snippet from edge-node showing KV cache misses and fallback to paging:

```
[03:12:08] WARN prefix_cache miss key=phash_v4:aa3f.. -> fallback=paging
[03:12:08] DEBUG kv_bucket lookup latency=12ms
[03:12:09] INFO stream chunk delay token_emit=220ms -> stall_detected
```

priya: looks like prefix-hash v4 changed the salting scheme; prefix keys now map differently causing namespace mismatch across some cache shards. Low hit rate -> more paging -> tail latency.

sam: what's customer impact? CS? @cs-ops any escalations?

cs-ops: we have 3 customers on dedicated clusters reported increased streaming stalls and two created support tickets. No broad outages but degraded UX (playback stalls, slow chat). One enterprise with SLA saw >0.5% requests over SLO threshold.

sam: ok need live mitigation. Priorities: 1) prevent further hitrate drop 2) stop rollout of v4 3) warm caches / enable fallback routing 4) handoff once stable.

maria: mitigation plan in order:
- disable prefix-hash v4 feature flag (ff-service)
- enable legacy-prefix routing (policy = prefer:phash_v3)
- trigger cache warmers for high-volume prefixes (warm-job)
- temporarily increase streaming timeouts to avoid client disconnects

alex: commands I'm about to run:
```
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://ff.redwood.internal/api/flags/prefix-hash-v4/disable

# flip routing policy
redwoodctl routing set default --prefix-policy=phash_v3 --apply

# start warming job for top 100 prefixes
redwoodctl job start prefix-warm --top=100
```

sam: do the ff disable and routing flip first. Hold on the warmers until we confirm hitrate changes. I'll coordinate with SRE to watch for regressions.

priya: I'm running a quick healthcheck hook to measure hit-rate across shards every 30s. If hit-rate > 70% we can stop further aggressive mitigations.

opsbot: ACTION_LOG: sam disabled flag prefix-hash-v4 at 03:16:11 UTC (run_id=run-99231).

opsbot: ACTION_LOG: routing policy updated to prefer phash_v3 at 03:16:42 UTC (txn=tx-7702).

maria: visual dashboards showing initial recovery: cluster A hit-rate climbed to 51% within 30s; cluster B to 46%. p99 trending down to ~1.1s. Still above SLO but moving in right direction.

alex: started warm-job for top prefixes at 03:17:25 UTC. Warmers seeded with real traffic replay to avoid cold misses.

sam: good. CS: can you message the three customers that we saw degraded streaming and we're actively mitigating (short note + ETA)? Keep it generic: rolling mitigation, no data loss.

cs-ops: will send now. Draft: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls; we've identified a cache roll that reduced hit rates and are rolling back the change. Expect improved latency within ~15-30 minutes. We'll follow up when fully resolved."

priya: monitoring automated checks: p95 back to ~220ms, p99 900ms and falling. Cache hit-rate aggregate now 74% (from 14%).

maria: seeing a small residual shard (eu-west-3) lagging at 48% hit-rate. Investigating cross-shard hash mapping for v3 vs v4 keys. Might need a targeted shard resync.

sam: prioritize eu-west-3. If resync needed schedule with minimal disruption: follow resync playbook step 2 (drain, resync, promote).

alex: logs indicate a small set of buckets still responding with v4-key format due to a stale config on a subset of nodes (deploy group: prefix-rotator-7). Starting an out-of-band reload on that group.

opsbot: DEPLOY: restarting prefix-rotator-7 group (rolling) at 03:22:10 UTC.

maria: after reload eu-west-3 hit-rate 81%. p99 now 420ms. Looks like the reload fixed the last inconsistent nodes.

sam: excellent. Summary for postmortem: cause = prefix-hash v4 salting change + incomplete rollout leading to inconsistent key formats -> cache miss storm -> increased paging -> streaming tail stalls and elevated p99. Mitigations executed: disabled v4 flag, routed traffic to phash_v3, warmed top prefixes, restarted stale rotator nodes.

priya: action items (assign):
- priya: own rollout gating improvements (feature flag check for cross-shard key compatibility)
- alex: add automated shard consistency check to preflight for prefix-rollouts
- maria: update runbook with immediate mitigation playbook and healthcheck thresholds
- sam: follow-up postmortem and customer impact note

cs-ops: customers notified and will follow up when postmortem ready.

sam: handing off to daytime on-call @maria for monitoring and postmortem. I'm going offline for a break. If anything regresses ping me.

maria: ack, taking over. I'll run the 1-hour check cycle and update the incident channel with final status + RCA link.
